| --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Bring the same fictional call packet to every demonstration
paragraphs:
Create two ordinary residential-service scenarios. The first caller requests a replacement estimate and gives a preferred day. The second is an existing customer asking to change an arranged visit. Neither scenario should include a real customer's details.

For the estimate, decide in advance which facts the office needs: requested service, service address, callback information and whether a visit was requested or actually booked. For the change, specify the existing appointment reference and what the caller wants changed. The receptionist must not turn a preference into a commitment your business has not authorized.

Use the same scenarios for each supplier. Ask to see the notification and the full record, not just a polished sample chosen for an unrelated industry. If the supplier cannot demonstrate a requirement, leave it unresolved rather than scoring it as included.

| Proposed check | Office requirement | Supplier demonstration result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Estimate status | Distinguish requested date from confirmed booking | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Existing visit | Identify the original visit and requested change | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Callback detail | Preserve the information the office needs to respond | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Unclear information | Make uncertainty visible and identify available source evidence | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Notification | Show what the intended recipient actually sees | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Follow-up owner | Establish the office role responsible for reviewing and acting | Record your own agreed procedure |

The final row is deliberately an operating decision. A service can deliver a useful record while the office still needs a person to review it. Do not treat a sent notification, opened message and completed callback as interchangeable events.

sections.title: Evaluate a short alert and a full record separately
paragraphs:
A short message may help a technician notice that the office needs attention. The person reviewing an estimate may need more context. Compare those tasks separately so an attractive notification does not hide an incomplete record.

Ask what happens when a caller corrects a phone number or changes their requested date during the conversation. The proposed demonstration should reveal whether the final output preserves the correction and labels any unresolved detail. This is a purchasing check to perform, not a claim about how any supplier performed in our testing.

Decide which person may consult additional source material and who can correct an office record. # AI receptionist call summaries: compare the office handoff

The best summary for your service office is the one that leaves your team with an understandable request and a clear next action. Before buying an AI receptionist, compare the actual output, its destination and the source material available when a detail is uncertain. A notification arriving does not establish that someone accepted the work.

Published by Revo, a competing AI answering provider. This documentary comparison uses public pages reviewed October 30, 2026. This guide does not establish custom summary fields, email-routing rules, export, retention periods or automated callback assignment for Revo.

| Product and documented approach | Buying distinction | What remains to verify for your account |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Upfirst: recipient and delivery rules; configurable highlights | Information extracted, questions asked and notification contents are separate controls | Selected plan, required fields, recipients and the actual short-text result |
| Abby AI: summary and source artifacts in app/portal, plus advertised notifications | The alert and the full call record may serve different office tasks | Exact entitlement, access and contents delivered through each chosen channel |
| Revo: dashboard summaries; recordings/transcripts in Crew and Fleet | Decide whether your team needs a summary alone or access to those additional artifacts | Supported workflow and selected plan; any requirement beyond the published scope |

These are documented distinctions, not observed comparisons of reliability. A supplier's description is a starting point for an account-specific demonstration.

## Bring the same fictional call packet to every demonstration

For the estimate, decide in advance which facts the office needs: requested service, service address, callback information and whether a visit was requested or actually booked. For the change, specify the existing appointment reference and what the caller wants changed. The receptionist must not turn a preference into a commitment your business has not authorized.

Use the same scenarios for each supplier. Ask to see the notification and the full record, not just a polished sample chosen for an unrelated industry. If the supplier cannot demonstrate a requirement, leave it unresolved rather than scoring it as included.

| Proposed check | Office requirement | Supplier demonstration result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Estimate status | Distinguish requested date from confirmed booking | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Existing visit | Identify the original visit and requested change | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Callback detail | Preserve the information the office needs to respond | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Unclear information | Make uncertainty visible and identify available source evidence | Leave blank until demonstrated |
| Notification | Show what the intended recipient actually sees | Leave blank until demonstrated |

Ask what happens when a caller corrects a phone number or changes their requested date during the conversation. The proposed demonstration should reveal whether the final output preserves the correction and labels any unresolved detail. This is a purchasing check to perform, not a claim about how any supplier performed in our testing.

Decide which person may consult additional source material and who can correct an office record. If your requirement includes a particular export, retention period, permission model or connection, obtain that exact scope in writing. Its absence from this comparison is not evidence that every supplier offers it.

For an office that reviews requests in a dashboard, Revo's published summaries may be relevant. If the office also needs recordings and transcripts, compare the applicable Crew or Fleet offer. Compare the complete purchase route before replacing a working phone arrangement to obtain one reception feature.

sections.title: Start with what your office already owns
paragraphs:
For a fictional two-person plumbing office, the public number may already be printed on vehicles and used by returning customers. The first question is whether the office needs a new team phone workspace or only coverage when its people cannot answer.

Write down the current carrier, account administrator, public number, devices and authorized routing controls. Separately record any need for employees to make calls, share an inbox or receive calls simultaneously. These are purchasing requirements, not assumed features of an answering subscription.

Choose one route to investigate first:

- **Keep the phone arrangement and add reception:** establish a supported connection and the handling work the receptionist may perform.
- **Buy a phone platform with reception:** establish both the employee-phone requirements and the autonomous-answering requirements.
- **Start with a new number:** establish the number service and who controls it before advertising it to customers.

sections.title: Compare actual purchase routes, not just product names
paragraphs:
| Offer reviewed | Documented purchase boundary | What the complete proposal must resolve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quo with Sona | Sona operates inside Quo; its FAQ requires a paid Quo plan to purchase the add-on. Quo pricing lists a new or ported local or toll-free number per user. | Required users, number allocation, current Sona allowance and additional usage, and the applicable phone-plan charges |
| GoTo Connect with AI Receptionist | The current plan page offers Phone System + AI Receptionist and CX Complete, with AIR credits. | Phone users and numbers, the selected package, credit consumption and extra credits; a credit count is not a dollar total |
| Aircall AI Voice Agents | Current pricing describes an agent route with or without a phone system, alongside broader phone-workspace products. | Which route the quote covers, any required accounts or seats, number arrangement, agent usage and applicable telephony |
| Revo reception on a compatible connection | Evaluate the published incoming AI answering, intake, supported booking and summaries for the selected plan. | Connection compatibility, required plan, usage and office follow-up; this guide does not establish number supply, porting or a phone workspace |

Sources: [Quo/Sona](https://www.quo.com/sona), [Quo pricing](https://www.quo.com/pricing), [GoTo Connect](https://www.goto.com/pricing/connect), [Aircall pricing](https://aircall.io/pricing/) and [Revo pricing](/pricing).

Do not import a minimum from one product into another. Aircall's employee-phone product and its agent route need separate assessment. Equally, a Sona allowance shown within a Quo plan is not evidence that someone can buy the same arrangement without the underlying Quo service.

sections.title: Build one complete package record
paragraphs:
Copy this record for every shortlisted route. Keep an unanswered field visible rather than filling it from a different product or an old rate card.

| Purchasing field | Written answer or evidence to obtain |
| --- | --- |
| Product and account prerequisites | Exact phone platform, agent product, plan and authorized account owner |
| Employee access | Required users or seats, who needs them and what each may do |
| Public number | New, retained or ported; account controlling it; any eligibility or separate charge |
| Reception usage | Unit, allowance, reset period, additional usage and excluded activities |
| Telephony | Applicable inbound, toll-free, external-transfer and other phone charges |
| Connected work | Supported calendar or system, permissions and actual result created |
| Remaining office work | Person responsible for messages, unanswered questions and unavailable-recipient cases |
| Exit | Cancellation process, number-control documents and unresolved requests to retain |

Aircall's [agent-billing help](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/28888299272733) separates agent participation from telephony and describes exceptions, while its pricing page includes native numbers and business telephony in its offer description. Obtain the applicable written arrangement; this guide does not resolve those statements into a universal all-in tariff.

Do not add minutes, calls and credits together. Estimate the same workload under each supplier's actual unit and rules.

sections.title: Inspect the handoff before changing the public number
paragraphs:
Use the same fictional estimate inquiry with each supplier. The caller gives an address, asks whether the business serves it and requests a visit. Ask the supplier to show the resulting message, requested time or supported calendar entry. Then ask what happens when the caller needs a person who is unavailable.

Keep employee calling and automated reception separate in the demonstration. A successful outbound call from a staff app does not prove that the receptionist can book an appointment. A captured preferred date does not prove that a technician accepted the work.

If the route requires moving a number, first identify the account and authorization needed to retain control. Use the separate [porting guide](/ai-answering-service/phone-number-porting) for migration planning. This comparison does not establish that a number is portable, authorize a transfer or promise uninterrupted service.

sections.title: Choose the narrowest package that meets the requirement
paragraphs:
Keeping an existing carrier may fit an office that needs supported incoming reception rather than a replacement phone workspace. A platform package may fit an office that also needs the documented employee-phone functions. Confirm compatibility and full terms in either case; neither route is automatically cheaper or easier.

Revo belongs in the reception comparison only within its verified scope. If a supplied number, a particular phone workspace or another unverified capability is mandatory, a different offer may fit better. Do not treat a pricing CTA as proof of functional equivalence.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs:
### Is a business number the same as an answering service?

No. Establish who provides the number and connection separately from who handles incoming conversations and what happens afterward.

### Does an included AI allowance make the whole package free?

No. Check the required underlying account, users, number arrangement, additional usage and applicable charges.

### Does this guide establish that Revo supplies or ports numbers?

No. Evaluate supported reception and connection requirements directly. Number provisioning and porting are not established here.

[Compare current Revo plans](/pricing) if supported incoming AI reception is the part your office needs, alongside the completed package record and the applicable phone-service proposal.

record.title: Southern Answering Service: Costs and Initial Commitment
record.description: Evaluate Southern Answering Service's initial agreement, minute-based quote and monthly renewal. Build a commitment timeline without inventing missing prices.
record.lead: A residential service owner evaluating Southern Answering Service needs more than a starting monthly figure. The purchase connects a defined period of service, a billable workload and instructions the office can actually maintain. Establish those together before forwarding customer calls.
record.intro: A residential service owner evaluating Southern Answering Service needs more than a starting monthly figure. The purchase connects a defined period of service, a billable workload and instructions the office can actually maintain. Establish those together before forwarding customer calls.

sections.title: What the published Southern offer establishes
paragraphs:
Southern's [contact-page FAQ](https://southernansweringservice.com/contact/) describes minute-based billing and plans starting at $39 per month. It also says service moves to a monthly agreement after an initial three-month agreement. The same FAQ says its answering rates do not increase for holidays, weekends or late-night calls.

Those statements do not provide a complete account quote. The reviewed FAQ does not specify the included minutes or every applicable charge for that starting figure. Do not invent an allowance, treat the headline as your expected invoice or assume that monthly renewal means immediate cancellation.

sections.title: Map the decision across the initial period and renewal
paragraphs:
The important question is not whether the website uses the phrase “long-term.” It is what your business would authorize, when it would begin and which process would end or change it. Ask the supplier to identify the applicable documents and resolve differences before accepting the offer.

Use this timeline with the actual proposed dates. A month is not automatically thirty days, and a billing date is not necessarily the first day calls are handled.

| Decision point | Information to record | Office check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before acceptance | Exact service, applicable agreement and complete price sheet | Same business name and requested scope across the documents |
| Before customer routing | Approved start date, instructions and test results | A named person accepts the supported call flow |
| Initial service period | Start and end dates, invoices and change process | Calendar reminders correspond to the agreement rather than assumptions |
| Later renewal | Renewal period, notice method and effective date | The account owner knows who must act and when |
| Exit or replacement | Routing handback, unresolved messages and access arrangements | The office can continue follow-up after the service stops |

This is a record of questions and evidence, not a proposed contract. Send interpretation questions to the person authorized to review your agreement. Keep a copy of the offer actually accepted rather than relying on a screenshot of a later promotion.

sections.title: Turn the starting figure into a workload-specific quote
paragraphs:
For a plumbing or roofing office, a useful quotation describes the calls you want covered. Separate an ordinary new inquiry, an existing-job change and a request for someone who is unavailable. These may require different handling work even when each starts as one incoming call.

Provide an anonymized workload estimate your business is authorized to use. Keep expected call counts separate from handled duration and from the supplier's billable unit. Do not convert a competitor's per-call package into Southern minutes by assuming every call has the same length.

Copy this quote card and leave missing answers unresolved:

| Item | Answer required for the selected Southern offer |
| --- | --- |
| Recurring base and billing interval | Written amount, due date and any advance payment |
| Included usage | Defined allowance and reset period |
| Additional usage | Rate, rounding and activities counted |
| Requested handling | Agreed intake, message and recipient instructions |
| Connected work | Supported system, permitted action and any separate charge |
| Start, change and exit | Applicable dates, notice process and responsible contact |

A blank field is not zero. Nor is a complete-looking estimate proof that all requested work is included. Ask the supplier to price the scope described in the same proposal and identify exclusions explicitly.

sections.title: Use the initial period to check the agreed operating scope
paragraphs:
Plan the office's acceptance checks before launch. For a fictional service inquiry, ask what information the receptionist captures, where it arrives and who can act on it. A message containing a preferred appointment time is not the same as a confirmed booking in the authoritative calendar.

Next, test an unavailable recipient under an authorized demonstration. Determine whether the result is another attempt, a message or another agreed action. A phone connection does not prove that a technician accepted responsibility or will attend a property.

Assign a person to review the resulting records and handle exceptions. Keep a small change log of approved instructions, the effective date and the person who accepted the change. These checks help establish whether the purchased scope works for the office; they do not create a performance guarantee or a contractual right that the supplier has not agreed to provide.

sections.title: Compare Southern with the handling model you need
paragraphs:
A staffed supplier belongs in the shortlist when your requirement is a contracted person handling the agreed conversation. Evaluate the actual scope and written conditions, not the assumption that all receptionist services perform identical work.

[Revo's current plans](/pricing) describe AI answering, intake, supported booking and summaries, with transfers and other features depending on plan and configuration. This guide does not establish outsourced human receptionists, Southern integration, a Southern-equivalent agreement or field dispatch for Revo. Keep technical advice, approved prices and job acceptance with the people your business authorizes.

The separate [agreement checklist](/ai-answering-service/answering-service-contract-checklist) helps organize operating documents. This page addresses Southern's named purchasing conditions and the unresolved quote that must accompany them.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs:
### Does Southern's starting price establish my complete bill?

No. Obtain the applicable allowance, usage rules, required tasks and other charges in the actual offer. The reviewed starting-price statement is incomplete for that calculation.

### Should I read monthly renewal as permission to stop immediately?

No. Confirm the initial period, later renewal and actual notice process in the agreement. This guide does not decide what any clause legally permits.

### Have you tested Southern's service quality?

No. This is a public-document buying guide from a competing provider, not a customer review, measured ranking or prediction of your results.

[Compare Revo's current plans](/pricing) alongside Southern's written scope, completed quote card and commitment timeline.

The important question is not whether the website uses the phrase “long-term.” It is what your business would authorize, when it would begin and which process would end or change it. Ask the supplier to identify the applicable documents and resolve differences before accepting the offer.

| Decision point | Information to record | Office check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before acceptance | Exact service, applicable agreement and complete price sheet | Same business name and requested scope across the documents |
| Before customer routing | Approved start date, instructions and test results | A named person accepts the supported call flow |
| Initial service period | Start and end dates, invoices and change process | Calendar reminders correspond to the agreement rather than assumptions |
| Later renewal | Renewal period, notice method and effective date | The account owner knows who must act and when |
| Exit or replacement | Routing handback, unresolved messages and access arrangements | The office can continue follow-up after the service stops |

## Turn the starting figure into a workload-specific quote

For a plumbing or roofing office, a useful quotation describes the calls you want covered. Separate an ordinary new inquiry, an existing-job change and a request for someone who is unavailable. These may require different handling work even when each starts as one incoming call.

Provide an anonymized workload estimate your business is authorized to use. Keep expected call counts separate from handled duration and from the supplier's billable unit. Do not convert a competitor's per-call package into Southern minutes by assuming every call has the same length.

| Item | Answer required for the selected Southern offer |
| --- | --- |
| Recurring base and billing interval | Written amount, due date and any advance payment |
| Included usage | Defined allowance and reset period |
| Additional usage | Rate, rounding and activities counted |
| Requested handling | Agreed intake, message and recipient instructions |
| Connected work | Supported system, permitted action and any separate charge |
| Start, change and exit | Applicable dates, notice process and responsible contact |

A blank field is not zero. Nor is a complete-looking estimate proof that all requested work is included. Ask the supplier to price the scope described in the same proposal and identify exclusions explicitly.

## Use the initial period to check the agreed operating scope

Plan the office's acceptance checks before launch. For a fictional service inquiry, ask what information the receptionist captures, where it arrives and who can act on it. A message containing a preferred appointment time is not the same as a confirmed booking in the authoritative calendar.

Next, test an unavailable recipient under an authorized demonstration. Determine whether the result is another attempt, a message or another agreed action. A phone connection does not prove that a technician accepted responsibility or will attend a property.

A staffed supplier belongs in the shortlist when your requirement is a contracted person handling the agreed conversation. Evaluate the actual scope and written conditions, not the assumption that all receptionist services perform identical work.

[Revo's current plans](/pricing) describe AI answering, intake, supported booking and summaries, with transfers and other features depending on plan and configuration. This guide does not establish outsourced human receptionists, Southern integration, a Southern-equivalent agreement or field dispatch for Revo. Keep technical advice, approved prices and job acceptance with the people your business authorizes.

The separate [agreement checklist](/ai-answering-service/answering-service-contract-checklist) helps organize operating documents. This page addresses Southern's named purchasing conditions and the unresolved quote that must accompany them.

### Does Southern's starting price establish my complete bill?

No. Obtain the applicable allowance, usage rules, required tasks and other charges in the actual offer. The reviewed starting-price statement is incomplete for that calculation.

No. Confirm the initial period, later renewal and actual notice process in the agreement. This guide does not decide what any clause legally permits.

No. This is a public-document buying guide from a competing provider, not a customer review, measured ranking or prediction of your results.
